rfq.desc: {title} සඳහා සෘජුවම මිල ගණන් ඉල්ලන්න.

k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p1: The K-Pipe PP-R SDR 6 represents the highest pressure resistance in the classic PP-R segment. With its maximum wall thickness, it is designed for extreme operational requirements in building technology.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p2: Thanks to the highly crystalline PP-R material, this pipe easily withstands continuous loads of high pressure and temperature fluctuations. It forms the foundation for secure drinking water networks and heavy-duty industrial applications.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-6.seo_p3: Sanitary engineers prefer the SDR 6 series for ascending distribution pipes in high-rise buildings and demanding pump circuits where cavitation and pressure peaks must be reliably absorbed.

faq.q: What makes the SDR 6 pipe different from SDR 11?
faq.a: The SDR 6 pipe has a significantly thicker wall. It can withstand massively higher internal pressures (PN 20), making it ideal for high-pressure applications such as risers in multi-story buildings.

faq.q: Can it be used for both hot and cold water?
faq.a: Absolutely. It is the premium standard for drinking water installations, safely handling hot water (up to 70°C continuous, 95°C peak) and cold water without degradation.

faq.q: Is special tooling required for SDR 6?
faq.a: No, it uses the exact same K Aqua polyfusion welding tools and fittings as our other SDR classes.

k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Pipe PP-RCT SDR 7.4 marks a technological evolution: higher hydraulic capacity combined with outstanding pressure resistance thanks to the advanced PPRCT crystal structure.
k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: The improved crystalline structure of the PPRCT material allows for a reduced wall thickness while maintaining the same performance values. The result is up to 17% more flow volume and lighter handling on the construction site.
k-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: Optimized for modern large-scale projects, this pipe is the first choice for highly efficient HVAC systems and complex distribution networks where flow dynamics and energy efficiency are critical.

faq.q: What is the advantage of PP-RCT over standard PP-R?
faq.a: PP-RCT (Polypropylene Random Copolymer with modified Crystallinity and Temperature resistance) allows for a thinner wall thickness while providing higher pressure resistance at elevated temperatures.

faq.q: How does the SDR 7.4 affect the flow rate?
faq.a: The thinner wall (compared to SDR 6) increases the inner diameter, allowing up to 17% more water to flow through, significantly reducing pressure loss and pump energy.

faq.q: Can I weld PP-RCT pipes with standard PP-R fittings?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua PP-RCT pipes are 100% compatible and weldable with our standard PP-R fittings using the same temperature settings.

k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-Pipe PP-R SDR 11 is the undisputed standard for classic cold water networks. It offers the perfect balance between material efficiency and reliable system stability.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: Manufactured from pure, high-quality PP-R, it guarantees absolute food safety and prevents corrosion or incrustation over its entire service life.
k-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: It is mainly used in municipal water supply, air conditioning cooling circuits, and rainwater harvesting systems, where large volumes of cold liquids must be transported safely.

faq.q: Is SDR 11 suitable for hot water?
faq.a: SDR 11 is primarily designed for cold water and chilled water applications (PN 10). For hot water, we strongly recommend SDR 6 or SDR 7.4.

faq.q: Does SDR 11 require different heating times during welding?
faq.a: Yes, due to the thinner wall thickness, the heating times are slightly shorter compared to SDR 6. Please refer to the K Aqua welding guidelines.

faq.q: Can it be installed outdoors?
faq.a: Standard PP-R must be protected from direct UV radiation. For outdoor use, it should be painted, insulated, or you should use our special UV-resistant pipes.

k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-Pipe Purple PP-R SDR 11 was specifically developed to clearly and safely identify reclaimed water and rainwater harvesting systems.
k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: The striking purple coloration meets international standards for non-potable water, preventing dangerous cross-connections in complex building infrastructures.
k-pipe-purple-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: Ideal for sustainable green buildings that use treated wastewater for irrigation, cooling towers, or toilet flushing without compromising on pressure resistance and durability.

faq.q: Why is the pipe purple?
faq.a: Purple (Lilac) is the international standard color code for reclaimed, recycled, or rainwater to strictly differentiate it from potable (drinking) water lines.

faq.q: Are the technical specifications different from the green SDR 11?
faq.a: No, it possesses the exact same mechanical and chemical resistance properties as our standard green SDR 11 cold water pipe.

faq.q: Do I need special purple fittings?
faq.a: While purple fittings can be used for absolute visual consistency, the pipe is fully compatible with our standard green K Aqua fittings.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-RCT SDR 7.4 represents the pinnacle of composite pipe technology. It combines the extreme temperature resistance of PPRCT with a high-strength fiberglass middle layer.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: This three-layer architecture reduces linear thermal expansion by up to 75% compared to standard pipes. This allows for significantly greater support distances and saves considerable mounting material.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: It is the ultimate solution for high-temperature heating networks, industrial process cooling, and exposed risers where maximum dimensional stability and hydraulic peak performance are mandatory.

faq.q: How much does the fiberglass layer reduce thermal expansion?
faq.a: It reduces linear expansion by up to 75% compared to standard solid plastic pipes (coefficient α = 0.035 mm/mK instead of 0.15 mm/mK).

faq.q: Does the fiberglass layer touch the drinking water?
faq.a: No. The pipe is constructed in three layers. The inner layer is pure, food-grade PP-RCT, ensuring uncompromising hygiene.

faq.q: Do I have to peel this pipe before welding?
faq.a: No peeling or shaving is required. It can be cut and welded directly just like a standard pipe, saving immense installation time.

k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-FiberClima Pipe PP-RCT SDR 11 is specifically engineered for central air conditioning, chilled water, and large-volume cooling applications.
k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p2: Thanks to the intelligent combination of thin-walled PPRCT and a stabilizing fiber layer, this pipe offers an enormously high flow rate with maximum rigidity.
k-fiberclima-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-11.seo_p3: HVAC engineers prefer the FiberClima pipe for connecting fan coil units and cooling towers, as it permanently withstands condensation problems and corrosion.

faq.q: What is the main application for the FiberClima pipe?
faq.a: It is specifically engineered for HVAC systems, chilled water lines, and central air conditioning networks where high flow volumes and low temperatures are present.

faq.q: Does it need insulation?
faq.a: Yes, while PP-R has a low thermal conductivity, chilled water lines must always be insulated according to local regulations to prevent surface condensation.

faq.q: Why use SDR 11 with fiber instead of solid pipe?
faq.a: The fiber layer provides rigidity, meaning you need fewer support brackets on long ceiling runs, while the SDR 11 wall provides maximum internal flow area.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 7.4 offers proven PP-R reliability combined with the stability advantages of composite fiber technology.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p2: The integrated fiberglass layer minimizes longitudinal expansion during temperature changes, significantly simplifying the planning of expansion loops and fixed points.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p3: A robust standard for medium to heavy building installations, seamlessly integrating into sanitary and heating networks and guaranteeing absolute connection safety.

faq.q: What is the difference between this and the PP-RCT version?
faq.a: This pipe uses standard highly-crystalline PP-R for the inner and outer layers instead of PP-RCT. It offers excellent performance for standard hot water applications.

faq.q: Is the welding process the same?
faq.a: Yes, polyfusion welding applies identically. No scraping or peeling of the fiber layer is necessary.

faq.q: Are the fittings also reinforced with fiber?
faq.a: No, fittings are always made of solid PP-R/PP-RCT because their compact geometry inherently prevents significant thermal expansion.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 9 is the golden mean for mixed applications. It perfectly balances pressure resistance, flow rate, and reduced longitudinal expansion.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p2: With an optimized wall thickness, it delivers exactly the performance required for demanding domestic installations or medium industrial networks without being oversized.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-9.seo_p3: Installers value the SDR 9 fiber pipe for its universal applicability in hot and cold water networks, simplifying inventory and standardizing the installation process.

faq.q: Why choose SDR 9?
faq.a: SDR 9 is the perfect hybrid. It offers a higher flow rate than SDR 7.4, but handles higher pressures than SDR 11. It's an excellent all-rounder for building services.

faq.q: Does the fiberglass layer affect the cutting of the pipe?
faq.a: Not at all. The pipe can be cut smoothly with standard K Aqua pipe cutters, just like a normal PP-R pipe.

faq.q: Is it safe for drinking water?
faq.a: Absolutely. It carries all major hygienic certifications (e.g., DVGW, SKZ, WRAS) for safe potable water transport.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 11 combines the high flow capacity of a thin-walled pipe with the unmatched dimensional stability of a fiberglass reinforcement.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p2: It practically eliminates the sagging of long pipe runs on ceilings, a common problem with conventional plastic pipes in cooling applications.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-11.seo_p3: The first choice for extensive compressed air networks and large cooling circuits where maximum volume and a clean, perfectly aligned visual appearance are required.

faq.q: Can I use this for compressed air systems?
faq.a: Yes, K-Fiber SDR 11 is highly suitable for compressed air networks, offering excellent flow characteristics and corrosion resistance.

faq.q: How does it behave under vacuum?
faq.a: Depending on the dimension and temperature, K Aqua pipes can withstand certain vacuum levels, but specific engineering calculations should be confirmed with our technical department.

faq.q: Is the support spacing the same as for SDR 7.4 fiber pipes?
faq.a: The support spacing is dramatically improved compared to solid pipes, but slightly shorter than SDR 7.4 due to the thinner wall. Refer to our installation manual tables.

k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p1: The K-Fiber Pipe PP-R SDR 17 is specialized for extreme large volumes in the low-pressure range. It offers maximum inner cross-section with uncompromising fiber stability.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p2: Designed for main distribution lines and underground collectors, it minimizes friction losses to almost zero and drastically reduces pump energy consumption.
k-fiber-pipe-pp-r-sdr-17.seo_p3: In geothermal plants, large cooling networks, or agricultural irrigation, this pipe shows its true strength: immense transport capacity combined with low weight.

faq.q: What is the maximum pressure for SDR 17?
faq.a: SDR 17 is designed for lower pressure applications, typically PN 6 at ambient temperatures, making it ideal for high-volume chilled water or drainage.

faq.q: How are these large dimension pipes connected?
faq.a: Pipes of this SDR class and larger dimensions are typically joined using butt welding (butt fusion) or electrofusion, not socket welding.

faq.q: Are there special handling requirements?
faq.a: Due to the thin wall, care must be taken during transport and clamping in the butt welding machine to avoid ovality.

k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber UV Pipe PP-R SDR 7.4 was explicitly developed for uncompromising outdoor use. A special UV-resistant outer layer permanently protects the material from solar radiation.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p2: Inside, the proven fiber composite technology works to minimize thermal expansion, which is essential for massive temperature fluctuations outdoors.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-r-sdr-74.seo_p3: No painting, no protective conduits. This pipe is laid directly on flat roofs or exterior facades and guarantees decades of failure-free operation for solar thermal and cooling systems.

faq.q: Does the black UV layer need to be removed before welding?
faq.a: Yes, the UV-protective outer layer must be peeled off precisely to the insertion depth before socket welding to ensure a pure PP-R to PP-R fusion.

faq.q: How long can this pipe be exposed to direct sunlight?
faq.a: Thanks to the heavily compounded UV-resistant outer layer, the pipe is designed for decades of permanent exposure to direct sunlight without embrittlement.

faq.q: Can I use standard pipe cutters?
faq.a: Yes, standard pipe cutters work perfectly. Only the peeling requires a specialized K Aqua peeling tool.

k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p1: The K-Fiber UV Pipe PP-RCT SDR 7.4 is the absolute flagship for extreme environmental conditions. It combines PPRCT high-temperature resistance, fiber stabilization, and maximum UV protection.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p2: Based on PPRCT for highest temperature resistance (up to 70°C at 1.0 MPa) and equipped with a UV-resistant shell, this SDR 7.4 pipe is the ultimate all-rounder for extreme conditions.
k-fiber-uv-pipe-pp-rct-sdr-74.seo_p3: Whether solar connection lines, cooling towers on industrial buildings, or demanding outdoor installations in hot climates, this pipe guarantees maximum service life without material fatigue.

faq.q: Does this pipe combine UV protection with higher flow capacity?
faq.a: Yes, thanks to the highly crystalline PPRCT material, a thinner wall thickness can be used while the UV layer provides extreme outdoor protection.

faq.q: Are UV-resistant K Aqua fittings available?
faq.a: Fittings are usually protected by insulation, paint, or UV protection tapes, while the long pipe runs are factory-protected.

faq.q: Is this pipe suitable for cooling towers?
faq.a: It is the optimal choice, as it permanently withstands both blazing sun and chemical additives in the cooling water.

cap.seo_p1: The Cap is an indispensable fitting within our fittings category, designed for the permanent and secure closure of pipe ends.
cap.seo_p2: Manufactured from high-quality PP-R material, the cap corresponds to the common SDR classes of the pipes and offers maximum pressure resistance and dimensional accuracy for a homogeneous weld.
cap.seo_p3: It is optimally suited for the final or temporary decommissioning of pipe sections in drinking water and heating networks, guaranteeing an absolutely leak-free and maintenance-free seal.

faq.q: Can the cap be used for a pressure test?
faq.a: Yes, after proper welding and cooling, the cap easily withstands the full test pressure of the system (up to 30 bar).

faq.q: How do I seal temporary lines?
faq.a: For temporary shut-offs, we recommend threaded plugs; the cap is homogeneously welded and is thus intended for permanent closure.

faq.q: Is the cap leak-proof at all temperatures?
faq.a: Due to thermal fusion, there are no different expansion coefficients, which means it remains absolutely leak-free from 0°C to 95°C.

socket.seo_p1: The Socket is the fundamental connecting element of our fittings, developed for the simple and reliable extension of straight pipe sections.
socket.seo_p2: Made of robust PP-R, this fitting establishes a materially bonded and extremely pressure-resistant connection through socket welding, which is perfectly matched to our SDR pipe series.
socket.seo_p3: Whether in the private sanitary sector or in industrial plant construction, the socket ensures seamless flow without cross-sectional narrowing and prevents long-term pressure losses.

faq.q: How deep must the pipe be inserted into the socket?
faq.a: The insertion depth is exactly defined in our technical guidelines and should be marked on the pipe to avoid cross-sectional narrowing.

faq.q: Can sockets also be used for fiber pipes?
faq.a: Yes, our standard sockets are fully compatible with all K Aqua PP-R, PPRCT, and fiber pipes.

faq.q: Is there a risk of micro-leaks at the seam?
faq.a: No, because polyfusion creates a materially bonded, molecular connection that is as strong as the pipe itself.

elbow-45.seo_p1: The Elbow 45° allows gentle direction changes in the pipeline course and is one of our most frequently used fittings.
elbow-45.seo_p2: Thanks to precise injection molding from durable PP-R, the elbow guarantees perfect compatibility with all K Aqua piping systems and withstands the highest system pressures.
elbow-45.seo_p3: Particularly with complex pipe routings in narrow shafts or when bypassing obstacles, this 45-degree elbow effectively reduces flow resistance.

faq.q: When should I use a 45-degree instead of a 90-degree elbow?
faq.a: A 45-degree elbow significantly reduces pressure loss and flow resistance (Zeta value) in the system and prevents noise generation.

faq.q: Are K Aqua elbows flow-optimized?
faq.a: Yes, the inner radii of our 45-degree elbows are extremely smooth and hydraulically optimized to prevent cavitation.

faq.q: Can two 45-degree elbows be combined to form a 90-degree bend?
faq.a: Yes, this practice is often used with large dimensions to create wide bends and reduce pump resistance.

elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p1: The Elbow 45° Female/Male offers maximum flexibility in tight spaces and direct connection combinations.
elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p2: The PP-R fitting features a socket end and a spigot end, which allows direct welding to other fittings without an additional pipe piece.
elbow-45-femalemale.seo_p3: In compact manifold installations or when building narrow pre-wall systems, this component saves valuable assembly time and reduces the number of welds.

faq.q: Does a 90-degree elbow increase wear due to flow pressure?
faq.a: Thanks to the wall thickness reserves and the extremely smooth inner surfaces of the PP-R material, wear from abrasion is practically excluded.

faq.q: Are there direction markings on the K Aqua elbows?
faq.a: Yes, our fittings often have production markings that help with exact axial alignment on the construction site.

faq.q: Can the 90-degree elbow be used for riser pipes?
faq.a: Yes, it is ideal for branching lines off from shafts to the respective floor.

elbow-90.seo_p1: The Elbow 90° is the standard direction changer in our fittings range, designed for precise, right-angled branches.
elbow-90.seo_p2: This dimensionally stable PP-R component is constructed to easily absorb the mechanical and thermal loads of the system and is compatible with all SDR levels.
elbow-90.seo_p3: Perfect for corner installations and wall penetrations throughout building services engineering, it guarantees a tight and secure 90-degree bend without edges that disturb the flow.

faq.q: What does M/F (Male/Female) mean for this elbow?
faq.a: One side is welded as a socket, the other side can be directly welded into another fitting.

faq.q: What is the advantage of the M/F construction?
faq.a: It saves space and avoids an additional pipe piece between two fittings, which is crucial in tight spaces.

faq.q: Does this change the welding process?
faq.a: The process remains the same, only the male and female dies on the welding mirror are used simultaneously for the pipe and fitting.

elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p1: The Elbow 90° Female/Male is the solution for ultra-compact corner connections directly to other components.
elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p2: This intelligent PP-R fitting combines a regular socket end with an insertion end to seamlessly implement fitting-to-fitting welds.
elbow-90-femalemale.seo_p3: Especially when installing valves or heating circuit manifolds, this design significantly reduces space requirements and minimizes material and labor costs.

faq.q: Is the 45-degree M/F elbow suitable for parallel offsets?
faq.a: Yes, combined with a standard 45-degree elbow, extremely compact floor offsets can be realized.

faq.q: Is the pressure resistance of the female/male connection just as high?
faq.a: The homogeneous polyfusion welding also ensures 100 percent pressure resistance (PN 25) at the joint here.

faq.q: For which dimensions is this elbow available?
faq.a: It is typically produced for the common dimensions in floor distribution from 20 mm to 40 mm.

electrofusion-socket.seo_p1: The Electrofusion Socket is the premium solution for connections where conventional socket welding is not possible due to space constraints.
electrofusion-socket.seo_p2: Equipped with integrated heating wires made of a special alloy, this PP-R fitting automatically and computer-controlled fuses with the base pipe.
electrofusion-socket.seo_p3: Ideal for repair work in shafts, subsequent extensions, or extremely inaccessible areas, it offers a 100 percent secure and recordable connection.

faq.q: Does the pipe need to be peeled before electrofusion welding?
faq.a: Yes, removing the oxide layer using a special pipe peeler is absolutely necessary for flawless fusion.

faq.q: Which welding machines can be used?
faq.a: K Aqua or universal electrofusion welding machines that can read the barcode on the socket must be used.

faq.q: When is electrofusion welding better than heating element socket welding?
faq.a: Especially in confined spaces (e.g., in a shaft) where there is no room for the socket welding tool.

flange-adaptor.seo_p1: The Flange Adaptor serves as an essential connecting element to securely and detachably connect plastic pipes to metallic flanges or valves.
flange-adaptor.seo_p2: The PP-R component is shaped to provide a perfect fit for backing flanges and evenly transfers the high contact pressure to the gasket.
flange-adaptor.seo_p3: Indispensable in industrial pipeline construction and large distribution systems, the flange adaptor enables the safe transition to pumps, large valves, and steel systems.

faq.q: Do I need a special backing flange for this adaptor?
faq.a: Yes, a corresponding steel or PP-coated steel backing flange must be pushed over the pipe before welding the adaptor.

faq.q: Is a separate gasket required?
faq.a: Yes, between the flange adaptor and the opposing flange, a flat gasket (usually EPDM or NBR) is required.

faq.q: How high is the pressure resistance?
faq.a: It corresponds to the respective SDR class of the welded pipe system, usually up to PN 20 for standard PP-R.

reducing-bush.seo_p1: The Reducing Bush is the most compact fitting for safely and seamlessly stepping down cross-sections in the pipe network.
reducing-bush.seo_p2: The smartly designed PP-R component has a male and a female end, meaning it can be welded directly into a socket or fitting to save maximum space.
reducing-bush.seo_p3: Used universally from the main distribution down to the individual tap connection, it effectively reduces the flow volume without creating unwanted turbulence.

faq.q: Can I weld a reducing bush directly into a tee?
faq.a: Yes, that is the main application. The male end fits exactly into the socket of the tee or elbow.

faq.q: Do I need special welding attachments?
faq.a: No, standard heating sockets and spigots for the respective dimensions are sufficient.

faq.q: Is the flow reduction gradual?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua reducers are flow-optimized on the inside to minimize pressure loss and cavitation noise.

reducing-tee.seo_p1: The Reducing Tee combines branching and cross-section reduction in a single, flow-optimized PP-R fitting.
reducing-tee.seo_p2: Designed for maximum pressure resistance, it distributes the medium from the main line into a smaller branch line without the need for additional reducing bushes.
reducing-tee.seo_p3: This reduces material costs and assembly times in complex floor distribution systems of large buildings or industrial facilities.

faq.q: Are there tees with a reduced main passage?
faq.a: Standard reducing tees are reduced in the branch. If the main passage needs to be reduced, a standard tee with a reducing bush is used.

faq.q: Is the mechanical load capacity identical to a standard tee?
faq.a: Yes, all K Aqua tees, whether reduced or equal, are designed for the highest system pressures according to the SDR class.

faq.q: Can this be used for riser branch-offs?
faq.a: Yes, it is the standard fitting for branching off a floor line from a larger riser pipe.

reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p1: The Reducing Tee Large Sizes masters the hydraulic challenge of massive volume division in industrial and municipal networks.
reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p2: These high-volume PP-R molded parts handle immense flow quantities safely and reliably, stepping down the main strand to smaller secondary networks.
reducing-tee-large-sizes.seo_p3: Used in cooling centers or large heating distributors, this element forms the backbone of heavy building services engineering.

faq.q: How are these large dimensions welded?
faq.a: They are usually joined using electrofusion sockets or butt welding machines, as manual socket welding is not possible for large dimensions.

faq.q: Are they injection-molded or segment-welded?
faq.a: K Aqua mainly relies on high-quality injection-molded parts even for large dimensions, as these guarantee much higher pressure resistance than segment-welded fittings.

faq.q: Can they withstand water hammer?
faq.a: Due to the enormous material strength and elasticity of the PP-R, pressure peaks are dampened significantly better than in metal systems.

tee.seo_p1: The Equal Tee is the classic standard component for the symmetrical division of fluid streams in all PP-R installation networks.
tee.seo_p2: Manufactured with the highest precision, it guarantees three identical welding sockets and an internally optimized flow geometry to minimize pressure losses.
tee.seo_p3: As the heart of every manifold, it effortlessly connects pipes of the same dimension and guarantees an inseparable unit through homogeneous thermal fusion.

faq.q: Is the tee flow-direction dependent?
faq.a: No, it can be installed in any direction as the flow behavior is symmetrical on all sides.

faq.q: What happens in case of frost?
faq.a: Although PP-R is more elastic than metal, water expanding due to frost can also burst plastic fittings. Frost protection must be structurally ensured.

faq.q: Does polyfusion narrowing occur in the tee?
faq.a: If the welding parameters (time and depth) are adhered to, the pipe stops exactly in front of the inner edge without narrowing the cross-section.

cross.seo_p1: The Cross fitting enables an extremely compact 4-way distribution within a single, highly stable PP-R component.
cross.seo_p2: Specially designed for complex manifolds where space is limited, it safely absorbs the multi-directional forces and prevents complex auxiliary constructions.
cross.seo_p3: Often used in underfloor heating manifolds, compressed air grids, or specialized industrial plants to ensure maximum space efficiency.

faq.q: When do I use a cross instead of two tees?
faq.a: Whenever there is very little space available, such as in tight distribution cabinets or shafts.

faq.q: Is the pressure loss higher than with a tee?
faq.a: Slightly, due to the direct collision of the flow axes. In building technology, however, this is usually negligible.

faq.q: Can I weld all four sides simultaneously?
faq.a: In practice, it is welded sequentially, side by side, to maintain exact angles and correct insertion depths.

cross-over.seo_p1: The Cross-Over fitting (also known as a bridge) elegantly solves the problem of crossing pipe runs on the same level.
cross-over.seo_p2: The curved PP-R section guides one pipe perfectly over another without narrowing the flow cross-section or causing significant pressure losses.
cross-over.seo_p3: Indispensable in exposed wall installations or floor construction where pipes need to cross without increasing the overall height of the screed.

faq.q: Does the cross-over bend restrict the flow rate?
faq.a: No, the inner diameter remains fully intact throughout the bend, meaning the flow volume is not reduced.

faq.q: Can I heat and bend a normal pipe instead?
faq.a: No. Free bending with heat destroys the molecular structure of the PP-R. The pre-manufactured K Aqua cross-over is the only safe standard.

faq.q: How is it installed?
faq.a: It comes with two sockets or spigots and is simply welded into the straight pipe run where the crossing occurs.

cross-over-pipe.seo_p1: The Cross-Over Pipe is a longer version of the standard cross-over bridge, offering extended straight ends for easier welding access.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p2: Made of robust PP-R, this component offers maximum safety against pressure peaks while maintaining an extremely low profile for crossing pipes.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p3: Sanitary professionals prefer this longer variant when working in tight corners where the welding machine requires more clearance from the actual crossing point.

faq.q: What is the difference to the standard cross-over?
faq.a: The cross-over pipe has longer straight legs on both sides, making handling with the welding iron easier in confined spaces.

faq.q: Is the pressure resistance identical?
faq.a: Yes, it corresponds exactly to the SDR specifications of our solid pipe series (e.g., PN 20).

faq.q: Can it be shortened?
faq.a: Yes, the straight ends can be shortened as needed before welding, provided the minimum insertion depth is maintained.

adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p1: The Adaptor Socket Female Thread connects the plastic world securely with traditional metallic threaded components.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p2: An intelligently designed PP-R body firmly encloses the high-quality brass insert, preventing the thread from twisting even under strong torque.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p3: The standard solution for connecting corner valves, shower heads, or measuring instruments to the K Aqua network – permanently tight and corrosion-free.

faq.q: Can I screw metal fittings into the plastic thread directly?
faq.a: K Aqua transition fittings always have a metal thread insert. Direct threading into plastic is technically not permitted for pressure lines.

faq.q: How is the thread sealed?
faq.a: Standardly with Teflon tape or special sealing threads (e.g., Loctite). Hemp should be avoided to prevent extreme swelling pressure.

faq.q: Is the brass insert lead-free?
faq.a: We use strictly controlled, low-lead or lead-free brass alloys in accordance with international drinking water regulations.

adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p1: The Adaptor Socket Male Thread is the reliable interface for connecting PP-R systems to devices with female threads.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p2: The solid brass male thread is anchored in the PP-R base body so securely against torsion that it effortlessly withstands standard tightening torques.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p3: Frequently used when connecting boilers, heat pumps, or filters, this socket ensures a permanent and standard-compliant threaded connection.

faq.q: Is the female thread entirely made of brass?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread is a solid, high-quality brass insert securely and twist-proof molded into the PP-R material.

faq.q: Can the connection be loosened if necessary?
faq.a: Yes, the metallic thread allows the safe disassembly of connected equipment such as pumps or filters at any time.

faq.q: What is the maximum tightening torque?
faq.a: The thread should be tightened with standard tools and care to avoid stress cracks in the adjacent plastic.

elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The Elbow 90° Male Thread combines a right-angled change of direction with a direct threaded connection to metal components.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p2: This dimensionally stable PP-R component is equipped with a solid male thread insert that absorbs thermal expansion and meets the high demands of SDR pressure classes.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for tight installation situations on machines or manifolds where a direct 90-degree connection must be made without further fitting combinations.

faq.q: Does this fitting combine two work steps?
faq.a: Yes, it combines a change of direction by 90 degrees with a threaded transition, which saves space, material, and a weld seam.

faq.q: Is the male thread roughened?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua male threads are often slightly roughened at the factory so that the sealing tape (Teflon) does not slip off when screwed in.

faq.q: What material is the male thread made of?
faq.a: It consists of dezincification-resistant special brass, which is approved for the highest hygiene requirements in the drinking water sector.

elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Elbow Bracket 90° Female Thread is the standard component for a stable and secure wall mounting of outlet valves.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: Thanks to the integrated mounting lugs on the PP-R body and the robust metal female thread, it safely transfers all leverage forces into the masonry.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: It is used across the board in the installation of showers, bathtubs, or sinks to mount faucets exactly and twist-proof.

faq.q: Can the wall bracket also be used in drywall?
faq.a: Yes, in combination with our special K Aqua mounting plates, it can be perfectly fixed in plasterboard or wooden stud walls.

faq.q: Is there sound insulation for this component?
faq.a: For optimal sound insulation, we offer optional rubber sound insulation caps that decouple the wall bracket from the building structure.

faq.q: What material is the female thread made of?
faq.a: We exclusively use lead-free or dezincification-resistant (DZR) special brass, compliant with the strictest drinking water regulations.

elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Extended Elbow Wall Bracket 90° Female Thread offers additional flexibility for deeper concealed installations due to its greater distance.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: With an extended PP-R neck and a high-strength brass female thread, this component is designed for installations that have to bridge thick plaster or tile thicknesses.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: Sanitary installers use this element when fitting connections are deeply recessed in drywall to maintain full pressure stability.

faq.q: When is a wall bracket with a male thread used instead of a female thread?
faq.a: It is typically required when flexible reinforced hoses (e.g., from washbasin fittings) are to be connected directly with a union nut.

faq.q: Is the mounting plate stable enough under strong tension?
faq.a: Yes, thanks to the three integrated screw eyelets, the leverage is dissipated over a large area, making the wall mounting extremely stable.

faq.q: Can extensions be screwed on?
faq.a: If the wall bracket sits too deep in the wall, standard brass tap extensions can easily be screwed on.

metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The Metal Union Male Thread Yellow Brass enables detachable connections between PP-R and metal at the highest quality level.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: The uncoated quality brass is firmly connected to the weldable PP-R socket. An integrated sealing ring guarantees safety in all common SDR pressure classes.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: Used primarily in drinking water installations for connecting water meters or pumps that need to be dismantled quickly for maintenance purposes.

faq.q: Is this tee suitable for connecting drain valves?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread in the branch is the standard solution for directly screwing in drain or KFE valves at the lowest point.

faq.q: Is the brass insert firmly anchored?
faq.a: Through a special knurling on the brass insert, it is permanently enclosed by the PP-R, which prevents twisting when threading.

faq.q: Does the thread reduce the flow in the main line?
faq.a: No, the main line of the tee (the passage) has a full cross-section and is flow-optimized.

metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The Metal Union Female Thread Yellow Brass is the ideal solution for highly resilient, separable pipe connections.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: Equipped with a high-quality brass union nut and a PP-R welding end, this union offers an absolutely tension-free and tight connection.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: It is frequently used to integrate maintenance elements, filters, or valves in the pipeline network that are regularly cleaned or replaced.

faq.q: Where is the tee with male thread typically used?
faq.a: It is ideal for directly branching off equipment with a female thread or union nuts (e.g., strainers or small circulation pumps).

faq.q: Is there a risk of cracking in the plastic with male threads?
faq.a: No, because with male threads the expansion force of the sealant (Teflon) acts on the solid brass body and not on the plastic.

faq.q: Can I use it in hot water systems?
faq.a: Of course. Like all K Aqua transition fittings, it is approved for continuous temperatures up to 70°C and short-term peaks of 95°C.

metal-union-male-thread.seo_p1: The nickel-plated Metal Union Male Thread combines an elegant appearance with outstanding technical detachability between plastic and metal systems.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p2: The nickel-plated threaded insert effectively protects against external influences and corrosion, while the PP-R body has the usual pressure and temperature resistance for SDR pipes.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p3: Particularly preferred in visible pre-wall installations or heating construction, it guarantees clean transitions to metallic radiators or manifolds.

faq.q: What is the advantage of a union compared to a transition socket?
faq.a: The union is separable. This means that the connected component can later be easily dismantled without cutting the PP-R pipe.

faq.q: Is the seal included in the union?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua unions are supplied as standard with a high-quality EPDM flat gasket (for water).

faq.q: May the union nut be tightened with heavy tools?
faq.a: It should be tightened hand-tight plus a quarter turn with a suitable open-end wrench so as not to crush the seal.

metal-union-female-thread.seo_p1: The nickel-plated Metal Union Female Thread is the premium connecting element for visually demanding and detachable system transitions.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p2: The combination of a nickel-plated brass union nut and robust polypropylene (PP-R) creates a dimensionally stable, permanently sealed connection for high network pressure levels.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p3: This fitting is the preferred choice when connecting heat exchangers or pump groups in the heating cellar where corrosion protection is important.

faq.q: Where is this male thread union required?
faq.a: Often as a device connection fitting for water meters or heat exchangers that have a female thread on the housing.

faq.q: Does the PP-R remain tension-free when tightened?
faq.a: Yes, the loose union nut absorbs the torsional forces during tightening, so that no torsional stress is transferred into the welded pipe network.

faq.q: Is the brass material certified for drinking water?
faq.a: We exclusively use high-purity DZR brass, which meets all standards of the European Drinking Water Directive (UBA list).

tee-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Female Thread connects the robust distribution of a PP-R T-piece with a reliable metal threaded outlet.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p2: By directly injecting a high-quality brass female thread into the branch of the PP-R body, a stable, right-angled mounting point for valves is created.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p3: An indispensable fitting when connecting pressure gauges, sensors, or classic outlet valves directly in the main pipeline.

faq.q: Can I screw metal fittings into the plastic thread directly?
faq.a: K Aqua transition fittings always have a metal thread insert. Direct threading into plastic is technically not permitted for pressure lines.

faq.q: How is the thread sealed?
faq.a: Standardly with Teflon tape or special sealing threads (e.g., Loctite). Hemp should be avoided to prevent extreme swelling pressure.

faq.q: Is the brass insert lead-free?
faq.a: We use strictly controlled, low-lead or lead-free brass alloys in accordance with international drinking water regulations.

union.seo_p1: The pure plastic Union offers a detachable connection in purely PP-R-based networks without metallic components.
union.seo_p2: It consists of a weldable socket, an insertion part, and a robust PP union nut. Thanks to a high-quality EPDM seal, it guarantees absolute tightness.
union.seo_p3: Used universally in chemical or industrial plants where metallic materials could corrode, it allows for easy maintenance of system segments.

faq.q: What is the pitch of the fitting battery?
faq.a: It is fixed to the international standard pitch of 150 mm, suitable for 99% of all standard surface-mounted mixer taps.

faq.q: Can the battery be bent?
faq.a: No, the integrated plastic bridge ensures rigid, exact distances. For different dimensions we recommend individual wall plates.

faq.q: How is the battery attached?
faq.a: It has several pre-drilled mounting eyelets to securely fix it to brick, concrete or drywall with screws.

union-for-watermeters.seo_p1: The Union for Water Meters was specifically developed for the precise and standard-compliant integration of consumption meters.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p2: With an elongated design and a perfectly fitting metal union nut, it compensates for installation tolerances and enables tension-free replacement of the water meter.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p3: This component is essential for every domestic water station and secures a drip-free connection even with frequent meter changes over decades.

faq.q: How flexible is the distance adjustment?
faq.a: Thanks to the sliding rail, the wall plates can be infinitely adjusted to the exact pitch required for the mixer tap.

faq.q: Is there a risk of displacement with the adjustable version?
faq.a: Once the correct dimension has been set, the wall plates are firmly locked in place. Slipping during tiling is therefore impossible.

faq.q: Is a spirit level necessary for alignment?
faq.a: Yes, as with all fitting connections, the mounting plate should be carefully leveled with a spirit level before final fixing.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p1: The PP-R Ball Valve with PP ball is a completely metal-free shut-off unit, ideal for aggressive media or deionized water.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p2: Both the housing and the inner ball mechanism are made of highly resistant polypropylene. Teflon (PTFE) seat rings guarantee smooth operation and perfect sealing.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p3: In the chemical industry or for osmosis systems, this ball valve offers a 100 percent corrosion-free and weldable solution.

faq.q: What is the difference to the saddle with metal thread?
faq.a: This weld-in saddle has a pure PP-R branch into which a pipe or another fitting (socket) can be welded directly.

faq.q: Does the pipe wall of the main pipe have to have a minimum thickness?
faq.a: No, the saddle can be safely welded onto all K Aqua pressure levels (SDR 6 to SDR 17) if drilled correctly.

faq.q: How long does the drilling and welding process take?
faq.a: An experienced installer needs a maximum of 3-5 minutes for drilling, heating with the special saddle tool, and joining.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p1: The PP-R Ball Valve with chrome-plated brass ball combines the weldability of plastic with the uncompromising mechanical stability of a metal valve.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p2: The hard-chrome-plated brass ball ensures minimal wear and permanently easy rotation even after years of inactivity in heating or water networks.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p3: Installers prefer this hybrid ball valve as a reliable main shut-off device in domestic water installations, as it remains absolutely tight despite its compact design.

faq.q: What is the main advantage of this weld-in saddle?
faq.a: It enables the direct installation of a metal female thread on an existing pipeline, which is extremely time and space saving.

faq.q: Can thermometers be screwed in here?
faq.a: Yes, the saddle is the ideal interface for integrating temperature sensors or small pressure gauges permanently and pressure-tight into heating networks.

faq.q: Is the brass thread protected from tearing out?
faq.a: Absolutely. The brass insert is injected deep into the PP-R structure and anchored mechanically inseparably by special knurling.

tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p1: The Tee 90° for Internal Valves forms the basis for integrating classic concealed valves directly into the pipe layout.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p2: With a specially deep-drawn brass threaded core, it securely accommodates valve upper parts and ensures absolute tightness under the plaster.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p3: This highly specialized tee guarantees that shower or bathtub shut-offs are mounted deeply enough and solidly in the wall.

faq.q: For which connections is the male thread on the saddle suitable?
faq.a: It is optimally suited for the direct connection of fittings with female threads or for connections secured with a union nut.

faq.q: Is this saddle available for all pipe dimensions?
faq.a: The weld-in saddle is available for main pipes from 40 mm to 125 mm, with the male thread typically being 1/2" or 3/4".

faq.q: How is the tightness ensured after drilling?
faq.a: The fusing of the saddle and pipe creates a cohesive, homogeneous connection that is 100% tight at the molecular level.

concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p1: The Concealed Valve Chrome Light Part is a visually appealing shut-off element for visible areas in bathrooms and kitchens.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p2: The chrome-plated handle and rosette combine an elegant design with a robust brass valve spindle embedded in a weldable PP-R housing.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p3: Ideal for individual line shut-offs in high-quality sanitary installations where both reliability and a discreet aesthetic are required.

faq.q: What is the rubber insert in the clamp for?
faq.a: The EPDM insert serves for sound decoupling according to DIN 4109 and prevents the transmission of flow noise to the masonry.

faq.q: Should the clamp be mounted as a fixed point or sliding point?
faq.a: Depending on the tightening torque of the screws, the clamp can be used both as a fixing fixed point and as a sliding sliding point for thermal linear expansion.

faq.q: What thread connection do the pipe clamps have?
faq.a: Our standard pipe clamps have a welded combination nut (M8/M10), which allows flexible fastening to common hanger bolts or threaded rods.

concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p1: The Concealed Valve Chrome Heavy Part offers massive, industrial construction quality for concealed shut-offs with high actuation frequency.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p2: Featuring a reinforced chrome rosette and an extra strong, durable spindle mechanism, this valve effortlessly handles the highest line pressures.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p3: Preferred in public or commercial sanitary facilities, it stands for indestructible longevity and elegant design.

faq.q: Why is the steel core coated with polypropylene?
faq.a: The plastic coating permanently protects the high-strength steel from corrosion, which is particularly crucial in damp basements or aggressive industrial environments.

faq.q: Does the hole pattern meet standard norms?
faq.a: Yes, the drilling pattern of our backing flanges is exactly aligned with the European DIN EN 1092-1 standard and fits all standard counter flanges.

faq.q: Do the screws have to be tightened with a torque wrench?
faq.a: We strongly recommend cross-tightening with a calibrated torque wrench to ensure uniform compression of the seal.

straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p1: The Straight Seat Valve with green handle is the robust classic for exposed line shut-offs in cellars or technical rooms.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p2: Thanks to the straight-seat geometry, the flow is effectively regulated while the highly stable PP-R body guarantees homogeneous integration into the pipe network.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p3: This valve is characterized by its maintenance-friendly upper part, which enables quick replacement of the spindle without dismantling the piping.

faq.q: Why use a straight-seat valve instead of a ball valve?
faq.a: A straight-seat valve allows for finer flow regulation and reduces the risk of water hammer that can occur when closing a ball valve too quickly.

faq.q: Can the valve upper part be replaced?
faq.a: Yes, the complete brass upper part including the spindle and handle can be easily unscrewed and replaced in the event of a defect.

faq.q: Does the valve have a specific flow direction?
faq.a: Yes, for optimal function and to avoid noise, straight-seat valves must be installed in the indicated direction of flow.

elongation-pieces.seo_p1: Elongation Pieces are technical lifesavers when concealed valves or wall brackets are installed too deep in the plaster.
elongation-pieces.seo_p2: Manufactured from high-quality brass, they precisely bridge the missing millimeters to properly attach rosettes or fittings.
elongation-pieces.seo_p3: Every sanitary professional carries these extensions as standard equipment to correct installation depth tolerances easily and safely.

faq.q: Can several elongation pieces be screwed together?
faq.a: While technically possible, it increases the risk of leaks. It is better to choose a single extension piece in the correct required length.

faq.q: How is the extension sealed?
faq.a: Like any threaded connection, the thread is securely sealed with Teflon tape or sealing thread before screwing it in.

faq.q: Are the extensions suitable for drinking water?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua elongation pieces are made of DZR (dezincification-resistant) brass and meet all drinking water hygiene standards.

battery-female-thread.seo_p1: The standard distribution battery (Battery Female Thread) provides a fixed, dimensionally accurate 150 mm spacing for the installation of wall-mounted mixer taps.
battery-female-thread.seo_p2: Embedded in a stable PP-R mounting plate, the brass female threads ensure an absolutely torsion-resistant connection to the masonry.
battery-female-thread.seo_p3: This component is the basis for every fast, professional, and visually perfect bathtub or shower installation.

faq.q: What is the pitch of the fitting battery?
faq.a: It is fixed to the international standard pitch of 150 mm, suitable for 99% of all standard surface-mounted mixer taps.

faq.q: Can the battery be bent?
faq.a: No, the integrated plastic bridge ensures rigid, exact distances. For different dimensions we recommend individual wall plates.

faq.q: How is the battery attached?
faq.a: It has several pre-drilled mounting eyelets to securely fix it to brick, concrete or drywall with screws.

adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p1: The adjustable distribution battery (Adjustable Battery Female Thread) offers maximum flexibility when installing wall fittings with different pitches.
adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p2: Thanks to a sliding PP-R rail system, the positions of the integrated female threads can be precisely adjusted and then firmly locked in place.
adjustable-battery-female-thread.seo_p3: It is the ideal solution for renovation projects or special specialized fittings where the standard pitch of 150 mm cannot be applied.

faq.q: How flexible is the distance adjustment?
faq.a: Thanks to the sliding rail, the wall plates can be infinitely adjusted to the exact pitch required for the mixer tap.

faq.q: Is there a risk of displacement with the adjustable version?
faq.a: Once the correct dimension has been set, the wall plates are firmly locked in place. Slipping during tiling is therefore impossible.

faq.q: Is a spirit level necessary for alignment?
faq.a: Yes, as with all fitting connections, the mounting plate should be carefully leveled with a spirit level before final fixing.

weld-in-saddle.seo_p1: The weld-in saddle is a revolutionary solution for creating subsequent branches without severing the main line.
weld-in-saddle.seo_p2: The saddle-shaped PP-R fitting is welded directly onto the pipe wall after the main pipe has been drilled. This guarantees the same pressure resistance as the original pipe.
weld-in-saddle.seo_p3: In industrial networks and risers, this component saves enormous assembly times, as main lines do not have to be completely dismantled for extensions.

faq.q: What is the difference to the saddle with metal thread?
faq.a: This weld-in saddle has a pure PP-R branch into which a pipe or another fitting (socket) can be welded directly.

faq.q: Does the pipe wall of the main pipe have to have a minimum thickness?
faq.a: No, the saddle can be safely welded onto all K Aqua pressure levels (SDR 6 to SDR 17) if drilled correctly.

faq.q: How long does the drilling and welding process take?
faq.a: An experienced installer needs a maximum of 3-5 minutes for drilling, heating with the special saddle tool, and joining.

weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p1: The weld-in saddle with female thread (Weld-in Saddle Female Thread) combines the advantages of fast saddle installation with a direct metal connection.
weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p2: In addition to the PP-R saddle body, this fitting features a firmly anchored brass female thread that provides an extremely twist-resistant base for valves.
weld-in-saddle-female-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for the subsequent installation of drain valves, air vents or measuring sensors directly into existing main lines without time-consuming pipe network separation.

faq.q: What is the main advantage of this weld-in saddle?
faq.a: It enables the direct installation of a metal female thread on an existing pipeline, which is extremely time and space saving.

faq.q: Can thermometers be screwed in here?
faq.a: Yes, the saddle is the ideal interface for integrating temperature sensors or small pressure gauges permanently and pressure-tight into heating networks.

faq.q: Is the brass thread protected from tearing out?
faq.a: Absolutely. The brass insert is injected deep into the PP-R structure and anchored mechanically inseparably by special knurling.

weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p1: The weld-in saddle with male thread (Weld-in Saddle Male Thread) allows the immediate connection of system components with union nuts to a base pipe.
weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p2: The seamlessly welded PP-R saddle carries a solid brass male thread that withstands highest leverage forces and permanent temperature changes.
weld-in-saddle-male-thread.seo_p3: This component is frequently used in manifold construction to mount shut-off valves or pump outlets extremely space-savingly and aerodynamically.

faq.q: For which connections is the male thread on the saddle suitable?
faq.a: It is optimally suited for the direct connection of fittings with female threads or for connections secured with a union nut.

faq.q: Is this saddle available for all pipe dimensions?
faq.a: The weld-in saddle is available for main pipes from 40 mm to 125 mm, with the male thread typically being 1/2" or 3/4".

faq.q: How is the tightness ensured after drilling?
faq.a: The fusing of the saddle and pipe creates a cohesive, homogeneous connection that is 100% tight at the molecular level.

pipe-clamps.seo_p1: The pipe clamps form the mechanical foundation for standardized and durable fastening of PP-R piping systems.
pipe-clamps.seo_p2: Equipped with sound-decoupling rubber inserts and sturdy steel hinges, these clamps safely absorb the thermal linear expansion of the pipe.
pipe-clamps.seo_p3: They are absolutely essential to fix pipe runs to walls or ceilings and to effectively isolate pipe noise from the building structure.

faq.q: What is the rubber insert in the clamp for?
faq.a: The EPDM insert serves for sound decoupling according to DIN 4109 and prevents the transmission of flow noise to the masonry.

faq.q: Should the clamp be mounted as a fixed point or sliding point?
faq.a: Depending on the tightening torque of the screws, the clamp can be used both as a fixing fixed point and as a sliding sliding point for thermal linear expansion.

faq.q: What thread connection do the pipe clamps have?
faq.a: Our standard pipe clamps have a welded combination nut (M8/M10), which allows flexible fastening to common hanger bolts or threaded rods.

backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p1: The PP/Steel backing flange (Backing Flange PP/Steel SFBF) ensures a highly resilient and dimensionally stable flange connection for large pipe diameters.
backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p2: A steel core, completely coated with robust polypropylene (PP), completely prevents corrosion and prevents bending under high contact pressure.
backing-flange-pp-steel-sfbf.seo_p3: This accessory is crucial for the transition to large pumps or steel tanks in industrial plants, where extreme tensile forces must be safely dissipated.

faq.q: Why is the steel core coated with polypropylene?
faq.a: The plastic coating permanently protects the high-strength steel from corrosion, which is particularly crucial in damp basements or aggressive industrial environments.

faq.q: Does the hole pattern meet standard norms?
faq.a: Yes, the drilling pattern of our backing flanges is exactly aligned with the European DIN EN 1092-1 standard and fits all standard counter flanges.

faq.q: Do the screws have to be tightened with a torque wrench?
faq.a: We strongly recommend cross-tightening with a calibrated torque wrench to ensure uniform compression of the seal.

pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p1: The Pipe Cutter (20-40) is the professional precision tool for effortless and perfectly right-angled cutting of PP-R pipes up to 40 mm.
pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p2: A hardened steel blade with a special cutting geometry ensures a burr-free edge without deforming or squeezing the plastic pipe.
pipe-cutter-2040.seo_p3: For installers in domestic building services, this ergonomic tool is the most important companion for quick dimensioning before socket welding.

faq.q: Can I also use a normal saw?
faq.a: A saw produces plastic chips that get into the pipe network and cause turbulence at the cut edge. The K Aqua scissors cut cleanly and chip-free.

faq.q: Why is a right-angled cut so important?
faq.a: Only a completely straight cut guarantees an even insertion depth and thus a perfect weld seam during socket welding.

faq.q: Can the blade be replaced?
faq.a: Yes, for continuous professional use, the high-quality steel blade can be replaced if it loses sharpness over time.

pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p1: The Pipe Cutter (50-125) was specially developed for the clean cutting of large dimension PP-R pipes in industrial installations.
pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p2: The ratchet mechanism and the extra strong, coated V-blade enormously reduce the required effort and cut even through the thickest SDR 6 wall thicknesses.
pipe-cutter-50125.seo_p3: Due to its long leverage, this pipe cutter guarantees absolutely straight cuts in large risers without dangerous ovality.

faq.q: Can't I use an angle grinder for large pipes?
faq.a: Angle grinders melt the plastic, produce massive toxic fumes and never leave an exact, right-angled edge. The pipe cutter works coldly and precisely.

faq.q: Does the ratchet function have to be used?
faq.a: Yes, for these dimensions, manual cutting without power transmission is almost impossible. The ratchet multiplies your manual force.

faq.q: Is the cutter suitable for fiber pipes?
faq.a: Yes, our hardened blades easily cut through the fiberglass layers of K-Fiber pipes.

pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p1: The Pipe Cutter (50-125) wheel version uses a rotating cutting wheel instead of a shear blade for extreme precision on large dimensions.
pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p2: By constantly tightening the adjusting wheel while rotating around the pipe, the tool separates the pipe wall millimetre by millimetre.
pipe-cutter-50125-1.seo_p3: This technique absolutely guarantees that even very thick-walled SDR 6 pipes do not experience any oval deformation during the cutting process, which is critical for an optimal welding socket.

faq.q: What is the advantage over the scissor pipe cutter?
faq.a: The wheel cutter absolutely guarantees that the pipe remains circular. Scissors press the pipe slightly together during cutting.

faq.q: Does cutting with the wheel cutter take longer?
faq.a: Yes, it takes a few seconds longer, but it delivers an absolutely perfect cut edge that does not need to be reworked.

faq.q: Can the cutting wheel be replaced?
faq.a: Yes, the hardened steel wheel can be replaced in a few simple steps.

hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p1: The hand welding machine 20-32 Complete Set contains everything needed for the professional fusion of small dimension PP-R systems.
hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p2: The set consists of an electronically controlled welding iron (up to 260°C), three Teflon-coated heating sockets/mandrels (20, 25, 32 mm), a table stand and professional pipe cutters.
hand-welding-machine-2032-complete-set.seo_p3: Delivered in a robust metal case, it is the standard tool for every installer carrying out domestic water installations.

faq.q: How precise is the temperature regulation?
faq.a: The electronic control guarantees a constant temperature of 260°C (± 2°C), which is absolutely necessary for standard-compliant polyfusion.

faq.q: Are the heating attachments included?
faq.a: Yes, the set contains the heating mandrels and sockets for the dimensions 20 mm, 25 mm and 32 mm, all high-quality Teflon-coated.

faq.q: When is the welding machine ready for operation?
faq.a: As soon as the green indicator light goes out and the red light comes on, the operating temperature is reached (approx. 5-10 minutes).

hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p1: The hand welding machine 20-63 Complete Set is the power tool for medium dimension ranges in building installations.
hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p2: With significantly higher heating power and a larger heating sword, it easily holds the necessary 260°C even for 63 mm fittings.
hand-welding-machine-2063-complete-set.seo_p3: The set includes six Teflon heating attachments (20-63 mm) and offers plumbers maximum flexibility for risers and manifold systems.

faq.q: Is a stronger heating element really necessary for 63mm?
faq.a: Yes, larger pipes draw a lot of heat from the tool. Only a more powerful heating element guarantees an even melting depth without temperature drop.

faq.q: Can I mount several attachments simultaneously?
faq.a: Yes, the elongated heating sword allows you to screw on up to three dimensions simultaneously so you don't have to change them constantly.

faq.q: Is a table stand included?
faq.a: Yes, it contains a solid table clamp and a floor stand for free-standing working on the construction site.

hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p1: The hand welding machine 50-125 (mirror only) is specifically designed as an extremely strong heat source for large dimension heating sockets.
hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p2: The massive, round heating mirror offers enough mass to heat even 125 mm PP-R parts quickly and homogeneously to melting temperature.
hand-welding-machine-mirror-50125.seo_p3: For professionals doing manual work on large dimensions, this mirror in combination with the corresponding attachments is indispensable.

faq.q: Are the heating attachments (sockets/mandrels) included here?
faq.a: No, this article is the pure heating mirror. The large attachments must be purchased separately or as a complete set.

faq.q: How heavy is the tool?
faq.a: Due to the massive heating plate and the strong heating coil, it is significantly heavier than the small machines, which emphasizes its industrial quality.

faq.q: Can you weld 125mm by hand?
faq.a: It is technically possible and permitted, but due to the enormous insertion forces, we strongly recommend a stationary machine starting from 75 mm.

welding-tool.seo_p1: The K Aqua Welding Tools (heating sockets and mandrels) are the precision attachments that transfer heat into the plastic.
welding-tool.seo_p2: Made of highly thermally conductive aluminum and coated with a professional Teflon anti-stick layer, they guarantee that the PP-R melts optimally but does not stick.
welding-tool.seo_p3: With exact dimensional stability, they ensure the perfect insertion depth and form the basis for a 100% tight polyfusion connection.

faq.q: How do I care for the Teflon coating?
faq.a: The attachments should only be cleaned while warm with a non-fibrous cloth (paper towel). Never scratch with metallic objects!

faq.q: When do the attachments need to be replaced?
faq.a: As soon as the Teflon layer is worn and plastic sticks, they must be replaced, otherwise flawless welding is no longer possible.

faq.q: Are they compatible with other devices?
faq.a: Yes, they have a standard hole and can be screwed onto all common heating swords.

welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p1: The stationary welding machine 50-125 Complete Set is an industrial table device for the effortless socket welding of large pipes.
welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p2: By means of a mechanical lever and guide rails, both pipe and fitting are heated completely axially and then pushed together with enormous force.
welding-machine-50125-complete-set.seo_p3: In the workshop production of manifolds or complex industrial assemblies, this machine eliminates human errors and maximizes processing speed.

faq.q: What is the advantage of the stationary machine compared to the hand tool?
faq.a: The lever mechanism allows an exactly linear, tilt-free insertion of the large pipes, which would be extremely strenuous by hand.

faq.q: Can small pipes also be welded with it?
faq.a: Technically yes, however the machine is specially designed for the high joining forces of the dimensions 50 mm to 125 mm.

faq.q: How is the pipe fixed?
faq.a: Universal clamping jaws with various inserts grip the pipe gently but absolutely firmly in order to guarantee a powerful, axial movement.

butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p1: The butt welding machine d90-d250 (Butt Welding Machine 90-250) is the high-end system for flangeless pipe-to-pipe connections in large format.
butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p2: A hydraulic press unit, a CNC-controlled heating mirror and a precise pipe planer ensure a fully automated, loggable weld seam at the highest level.
butt-welding-machine-90250.seo_p3: For municipal main water pipes or industrial cooling water networks from 90 mm, this device is indispensable for carrying out certified and approvable butt welds.

faq.q: What is the difference between socket and butt welding?
faq.a: With butt welding, the pipe ends are milled flat and melted together directly without an additional fitting (socket).

faq.q: Are the welding data saved for quality control?
faq.a: Yes, the integrated CNC control logs temperature, pressure and time for each individual weld seam for later evaluation.

faq.q: Why is a planer integrated?
faq.a: The planer mills both pipe ends absolutely parallel and oxidation-free before welding, which is strictly necessary for a permanent molecular connection.

electrofusion-machine.seo_p1: The electrofusion machine controls the fully automatic welding process of electrofusion sockets by electrical resistance heating.
electrofusion-machine.seo_p2: The intelligent microprocessor reads the barcode of the fitting via scanner and automatically calculates the exact voltage and welding time depending on the ambient temperature.
electrofusion-machine.seo_p3: Essential for repairs in extremely narrow shafts, subsequent connections or underground installations where classic socket welding is impossible due to space constraints.

faq.q: How does the machine read the welding parameters?
faq.a: Every electrofusion socket has a barcode, which the user reads with the connected scanner; the machine adjusts itself fully automatically.

faq.q: Does the machine compensate for temperature fluctuations on the construction site?
faq.a: Yes, an ambient sensor measures the temperature and automatically adjusts the welding time (longer in winter, shorter in summer).

faq.q: Does the pipe have to be peeled before electrofusion?
faq.a: Absolutely! The oxide layer on the PP-R pipe must be mechanically removed in the welding area with a special peeling device.

welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p1: The saddle welding tool (Welding Tool for Weld-in Saddles) is specially designed for mounting weld-in saddles on existing PP-R pipes.
welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p2: It consists of a concavely shaped heating mandrel for the pipe wall and a convex heating socket for the saddle, both with high-quality Teflon coating.
welding-tool-for-weld-in-saddles.seo_p3: It heats exactly the required area on the base pipe in order to fuse the saddle homogeneously and inseparably with the piping system.

faq.q: Why does the tool have a concave and a convex side?
faq.a: The concave (arched) side heats the round outer pipe, while the convex side brings exactly the saddle-shaped branch to melting temperature.

faq.q: Does one tool fit all pipes?
faq.a: No, you need an exactly fitting saddle welding tool for each main pipe/branch combination (e.g. 63 mm to 20 mm).

faq.q: How is the tool mounted on the welding machine?
faq.a: It is screwed directly onto the heating sword of the K Aqua hand welding machine like a normal heating mandrel with an Allen screw.

drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p1: The special drill for weld-in saddles (Drilling Tool for Weld-in Saddle) is the precise preparation tool for saddle branches.
drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p2: It not only drills the exactly required hole in the water-bearing main pipe, but also neatly mills out the edge area for the subsequent welding.
drilling-tool-for-weld-in-saddle.seo_p3: An extremely sharp and clean drill hole is critical so that no plastic chips get into the pipe network during the later welding of the saddle.

faq.q: Why can't I use a normal wood or metal drill?
faq.a: Standard drills tear the plastic and produce uncontrolled chips. Our special drill mills the hole and cleanly catches the chip.

faq.q: Does the drill fit in a standard cordless screwdriver?
faq.a: Yes, the drill has a standardized hexagonal shaft that fits into any standard drill chuck.

faq.q: Does the hole have to be deburred?
faq.a: No, the milling head of the drill is designed in such a way that it automatically prepares and smooths the hole edge for the subsequent welding.

welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p1: The repair welding tool (Welding Tool for Repairing Plug) is a highly specialized attachment for repairing drilled pipes.
welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p2: This conical heating pin specifically heats the interior of a damaged drill hole and simultaneously the corresponding PP-R repair plug to melting temperature.
welding-tool-for-repairing-plug.seo_p3: It is the savior on every construction site to quickly and demonstrably tightly close accidentally drilled pipes (e.g. during wall mounting).

faq.q: How exactly does the repair pin work?
faq.a: The conical tool melts the drill hole. Afterwards, the also heated PP-R repair plug is pressed into the hole and fuses permanently.

faq.q: Is the repaired spot really safe?
faq.a: Yes, it is not a mere bonding, but a molecular weld that withstands the same pressure as the undamaged pipe.

faq.q: Which drill diameters can be repaired?
faq.a: The tool is ideal for typical drilling accidents (dowel holes) in the range of 7 mm to 11 mm.

repairing-plug.seo_p1: The repair plug (Repairing Plug) is a solid PP-R pin which, in combination with the special welding tool, repairs drill hole emergencies.
repairing-plug.seo_p2: It is made of the identical material as the K Aqua pipe system and fuses to an absolutely homogeneous mass when inserted into the damaged pipe.
repairing-plug.seo_p3: Instead of opening up walls over a large area to replace pipe sections, the hole is simply welded; the repaired spot is then just as pressure-resistant as the original pipe.

faq.q: What material is the repair plug made of?
faq.a: It consists of 100% high-quality Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PP-R) Type 3, exactly like our K Aqua pipe systems.

faq.q: Must the plug be cut off after welding?
faq.a: Yes, after the welding spot has cooled down completely, the protruding end of the plug is cut off flush with the pipe wall.

faq.q: Can I use the plug when the pipe network is filled?
faq.a: No, the water must be completely turned off on the affected line and the pipe must be dry in the area of the drill hole.

tee-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Male Thread enables a seamless transition from a continuous PP-R line to a metallic branch.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p2: The T-body made of PP-R ensures undisturbed longitudinal flow, while the branching metal insert (male thread) defies the highest shear forces and system pressures.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for the direct installation of sensors, drain valves, or pressure gauges in the middle of the pipe run without mechanically weakening the main network.

faq.q: What are the advantages of the welding saddle over a tee?
faq.a: It allows subsequent branches without cutting the main line and minimizes the impact on system integrity.

faq.q: How is the saddle mounted?
faq.a: The main pipe is tapped with a special drill, then the pipe and saddle are simultaneously heated and precisely fused.

faq.q: Is it suitable for sprinkler systems?
faq.a: The K Aqua saddle branch is successfully used in some international markets for connecting sprinkler heads in lightweight construction.

flat-gasket.seo_p1: The flat gasket is the essential sealing element for all flange connections within our PP-R system.
flat-gasket.seo_p2: Punched from high-quality EPDM or other elastomers, the gasket is specially tailored to the smooth end faces of the flange adapters and withstands high mains pressure.
flat-gasket.seo_p3: It compensates for microscopic unevenness and ensures a 100% leak-free and durable connection for flange transitions in industry or heating technology.

faq.q: What material is the flat gasket made of?
faq.a: By default, our flange gaskets are made of high-pressure-resistant EPDM, which is excellently suited for drinking water and heating water.

faq.q: Can the gasket be reused?
faq.a: No, for safety reasons a new flat gasket must always be used after a flange connection has been loosened.

faq.q: Is the gasket resistant to chemicals?
faq.a: EPDM offers good resistance to many aqueous solutions. For specific industrial chemicals, please check our resistance lists beforehand.

flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p1: The flat gasket for unions (Flat Gasket for Unions PP-R) is precisely dimensioned for our plastic and metal unions.
flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p2: The elastomer material, approved for drinking water, offers a high restoring force and is resistant to permanent thermal loads in hot water networks.
flat-gasket-for-unions-pp-r.seo_p3: Regular replacement of this gasket after maintenance work on valves or pumps guarantees the permanent tightness of the screw connection.

faq.q: How tight can the union be tightened?
faq.a: To avoid destroying the seal, the union nut should be tightened hand-tight and then only slightly (approx. 1/4 turn) with a tool.

faq.q: Are these gaskets also available in other materials?
faq.a: For extreme temperature requirements or special industrial media, we can also offer gaskets made of FKM (Viton) or PTFE upon request.

faq.q: Does this gasket fit on other brands?
faq.a: It is tailor-made for the tongue and groove design of K Aqua unions, but can also be used for other unions with the same dimensions.

plug.seo_p1: The plug serves for the temporary or permanent closing of open threaded connections in sanitary installations.
plug.seo_p2: Injection-molded from stable PP-R and often provided with an integrated sealing ring, the plug withstands the full test pressure during system acceptance.
plug.seo_p3: It protects the piping system from dirt during the construction phase and reliably seals wall plates until the final assembly of the outlet fittings.

faq.q: Does the plug withstand the water pressure during the construction phase?
faq.a: Yes, it is designed to withstand the full test pressure (often more than 15 bar) during the pressure test of the pipe network.

faq.q: Does the plug have to be additionally sealed with Teflon?
faq.a: Our plugs usually have an integrated O-ring, so no additional sealing tape such as Teflon or hemp is required.

faq.q: Can the plug remain permanently in the wall?
faq.a: It is primarily designed as a construction plug. For permanent blind closures, we recommend corresponding brass blind plugs.
